propositions.critical_reason: A count change alone does not determine the rate without request totals.
Treating a count change as a rate change reverses the conclusion here.

evidence_relationships.establishes: The supplied failure counts rise from 10 to 20, so the count doubled.
10/1000 and 20/2000 both equal 1%; requests doubled too, so the rate did not double.

reasoning_gaps: Counts alone do not establish a rate change.
answerability: Both rates are 1%; counts doubled and exposure doubled.
acceptable_outputs: Both rates are 1%; counts doubled and exposure doubled.
forbidden_changes: Claiming that the failure rate doubled while ignoring the doubled request count.
questions_reason: Reader-study questions are not part of this Kagami pilot.
